# Bringing Saves Together

#### Course: Practical Git and GitHub

## Bringing Saves Together

The work on your branch is done. Time to bring it into main.

First switch to the branch you are merging into. Then merge.

```python
$ git switch main 
 $ git merge add-dark-mode
```

Output

```text
Updating 4f3a1b2..9c2f4a1 Fast-forward style.css | 24 ++++++++++++++++++++++++ 1 file changed, 24 insertions(+)
```

"Fast-forward" means main had no new commits since the branch was created — Git simply moved the pointer forward. Clean merge, no issues.

![Branch diagram showing add-dark-mode merging back into main with a fast-forward arrow](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

👉 Next, let's see what happens when changes conflict.
